query: In VS FRIEND, the guest scans the host's QR code and the WebRTC data channel never reaches open. Please trace the flow through js/net/sdp.js, js/net/handshake.js and js/net/session.js and work out where the offer/answer exchange stalls, and whether ICE or TURN config is to blame.
vs friend room codes r not working, i type the code my buddy gave me and it just sits on 'connecting' forever. nostr relay issue maybe?? can u figure out whats going on

Two players race the same lap but the replicated rival on my screen jitters and then drifts several metres off the host's version of it after a few laps. Something desyncs between peers; find out why.

tests/specs/multiplayer-npeer.spec.js fails when a third peer joins: the seat assignment in js/net/lobby.js looks wrong and js/net/rendezvous.js reports a duplicate slot. Diagnose the lobby flow and say what breaks.

Guests on a strict corporate NAT can join a lobby but never get a media path, and the build handshake mismatch warning appears for one of them only. Check whether a TURN fallback exists and why the peers disagree on build version.

The multiplayer lobby screen traps keyboard focus, and pressing Escape on the room-code dialog doesn't close it or return to the previous menu. Fix the back behaviour and the selected-state announcements for screen readers.

The phone pad controller connects by scanning a QR but the tilt steering on the phone is inverted and the dead zone feels huge once it's paired. Look at js/input/phone-pad.js and tune the steering response.
In a session with the AI field, the rival cars keep diving too aggressively into the player at turn 1 and then get stuck in the pit lane. Adjust the overtake and brake target behaviour in ai-drive.
